name: Vegyn (Joe Thornalley)
notes: "**He taught himself boom-bap programming**, and that is the audible base — a sampled kick and snare with the backbeat on 2&4, swung 16ths, and lo-fi/bit-crushed timbres — which he then dismantles." So the swing sits at the classic MPC value rather than the lane's, the snare is `backbeat_24` with heavy ghosting, and the whole kit is deliberately thin: his credited contributions are "a co-produced track and **a drum part on another**, i.e. he is brought in specifically for percussion and texture. Model crushed, off-grid, deliberately thin drums rather than a full trap kit." Crushed and off-grid is the low `quantizeStrength` with a large `snare.offGridMs`; thin is a low perc density and a hat carpet well under the lane's. The 808 stays, but not as a bassline voice in the lane's sense: "a distorted or bit-reduced sub used as a texture as much as a pitch; **no long sliding 808**" — hence `sustain` `staccato`, `distortion` `heavy` and a `slideProb` near the floor. Harmony is "inherited rather than written" — a filtered pad or chopped fragment over a 2-to-4-bar cell with no cadence. ⚠ `confidence` is **low**, mirroring the entry's medium-low: "his specific track credits and boom-bap foundation are sourced; the rest is inference". ⚠ Every number here is **INFERRED**, including `bpm.mode`. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 979/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.16 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "chopped and pitched samples, granular textures, and heavily-processed synths; his own releases and label compilations are electronic rather than R&B, so model an instrumental, hookless variant alongside the vocal work. Also credited on major rap albums.", and every claim in it still holds after the change. ⚠ **`drums.kick.lockTo808` override removed (2026-08-17, 808 gate)**, so this kick inherits `trap-soul`'s 0.8. `bass808::every_shipped_model_with_an_808_produces_a_playable_line` reported "vegyn seed 11: no 808 at all": the engine reads the number as the share of the kick's onsets the sub plays and rolls it per onset, so 0.4 against a kick of two or three hits a bar extinguishes the whole lane on roughly a third of four-bar patterns. The entry says the opposite in as many words — "**The 808 stays**, but not as a bassline voice in the lane's sense: a distorted or bit-reduced sub used as a texture as much as a pitch; no long sliding 808" — and every claim in that sentence is carried by the parameters that are NOT touched here: `sustain: staccato`, `distortion: heavy`, `clipping: true` and a `slideProb` of 0.06 at the floor. The entry gives no line about how often the sub sounds, so the override is dropped rather than re-tuned and the lane's own value stands.
